table.retrieve:
select 
	invoicecount = ISNULL(COUNT(invoicecount), 0),
	GrossSales =isnull(sum(GrossSales),0),
	SaleDiscount =isnull(sum(SaleDiscount),0),
	saleinvtotal=isnull(sum(saleinvtotal),0),
	srinvtotal=ISNULL(sum(srinvtotal),0), 
	netsale=ISNULL(sum(saleinvtotal - srinvtotal),0),
	cgs=ISNULL(sum(cost_of_sale - cost_of_saleRet),0),
	profitamt=ISNULL(sum(saleinvtotal - srinvtotal - cost_of_sale + cost_of_saleRet),0),
	profitperc=(ISNULL(sum(saleinvtotal - srinvtotal - cost_of_sale + cost_of_saleRet), 0) * 100) / ISNULL(CASE sum(saleinvtotal - srinvtotal) WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE sum(saleinvtotal - srinvtotal) END,1),
	Expenses = SUM(Expenses),
	date=max(date)
from
		(SELECT 
					type = 'S',
					invoicecount = COUNT(SL.saleinvcode),
					grosssales = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.saleprice),
					salediscount = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.itemflatdisc) + 
						sum(sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (sd.discperc * 0.01)) +
						sum(sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (SL.DiscPerc * 0.01)) + ISNULL(SL.FlatDisc, 0) ,
					saleinvtotal=dbo.fn_getsaleinvtotal(SL.saleinvcode),
					srinvtotal=0,
					cost_of_sale=sum( (SD.looseqty + SD.BonusQty) * CASE :ai_pricetype WHEN 5 THEN sd.rppunitrate ELSE SD.avgprice END),
					cost_of_saleRet=0,
					day_of_year=DATEPART ( y , date ),
					Expenses = 0.00,
					date=max(SL.date)
			FROM saleledger SL,
					saledetail SD
			WHERE date>=:adt_sdate and date<=:adt_edate and
					SL.salecatcode IN (:ai_saletype) and  
	 				SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode  and
					SD.gcode IN (:aa_godown)
			GROUP BY DATEPART ( y , date ),
						 SL.saleinvcode, sl.flatdisc
			UNION ALL
			SELECT
					type = 'R',
					invoicecount = 0,
					GrossSales=0.00, salediscount = 0.00, saleinvtoal=0,
					srinvtotal=dbo.fn_getsrinvtotal(SRL.srinvcode),
					cost_of_sale=0,
					cost_of_saleret=sum( (SRD.looseqty + SRD.BonusQty) * SRD.avgprice),
					day_of_year=DATEPART ( y , date ),
					Expenses = 0.00,
					Date=max(SRL.date)
			FROM srledger SRL, srdetail SRD
			WHERE SRL.Date BETWEEN :adt_sdate AND :adt_edate AND
					SRL.SRCatCode IN (:ai_saletype) AND 
					SRL.srinvcode=SRD.srinvcode AND
					SRD.gcode IN (:aa_godown)
			GROUP BY DATEPART ( y , date ),
						 SRL.srinvcode
			UNION ALL
			SELECT 
				type = 'E',
				invoicecount = 0,
				grosssales = 0.00,
				salediscount = 0.00,
				saleinvtotal= 0.00,
				srinvtotal=0.00,
				cost_of_sale= 0.00,
				cost_of_saleRet=0,
				day_of_year=DATEPART(y, V.Date),
				Expenses = SUM(V.Debit - V.Credit),
				date=MAX(V.date)
			FROM
				VirtualGL V, 
				Accounts A, 
				SubAccounts S, 
				CategoryAccounts C, 
				MainAccounts M
			WHERE
				M.MainAccCode = 5 AND 
				M.MainAccCode = C.MainAccCode AND
				C.CatAccCode = S.CatAccCode AND
				S.SubAccCode = A.SubCode AND
				A.AccCode > 20 AND
				(A.AccCode = V.AccCode OR A.AccCode = V.AlternateAccCode) AND
				V.Date BETWEEN :adt_sdate AND :adt_edate
			GROUP BY
				V.Date)  T1
GROUP BY 
	day_of_year
ORDER BY
	day_of_year

objects.name: compute_7
objects.expression: ( sum( profitamt for all) / if(sum( netsale for all)=0, 1, sum( netsale for all)) ) * 100
